name: Schwarld Hight
source:
A criminal rumored to be a high-ranking member of the Cult. He is known as "Immortal Schwarld" after dying and reappearing multiple times.
Sousuke's nemesis.

[spoiler] In fact, he is a keeper with the ability of creating clones. As long as the real Schwarld is alive, he cannot be killed. [/spoiler]
